evals.prompt: In a labeled temp vault, run cross-linker after a fixture ingest left unlinked mentions of knowledge-graphs and Jane Doe on projects/demo/demo.md.
evals.expected_output: Registry from frontmatter; EXTRACTED/INFERRED links applied inline or Related; AMBIGUOUS skipped; Cross-Link Report produced; log/hot updated.

assertions.text: Builds the page registry from frontmatter fields (title, aliases, tags, summary) — not full-body preload for every page
Applies only EXTRACTED (score ≥6) and INFERRED (score 3–5) candidates; skips AMBIGUOUS (score 1–2) unless the user asked to connect loose pages
Wraps the first natural body mention in [[wikilinks]]; does not link inside code fences or YAML frontmatter; no self-links or double-links
Produces a Cross-Link Report with Links Added table (confidence, placement, relationship types), orphans remaining, and pages skipped
Appends a CROSS_LINK line to log.md and updates hot.md Recent Activity after writes

evals.prompt: Temp vault is a standalone Git repository with uncommitted changes. Run cross-linker and attempt to add links.
evals.expected_output: Pre-write snapshot via git add/commit; if snapshot fails, abort with zero vault writes. On success, include SNAPSHOT_SHA in the report.

assertions.text: Checks whether OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH is the Git toplevel (standalone vault repo) before the first write
Takes a pre-write snapshot (commit or record HEAD) when the vault is a standalone Git repo
Aborts the skill without writing any vault files if git add or git commit for the snapshot fails
Includes SNAPSHOT_SHA in the final report when a snapshot was taken and writes occurred

evals.prompt: Fixture vault contains a redirect stub entities/old-jane.md with redirects_to: pointing at entities/jane-doe.md. Body text on another page mentions 'Jane Doe' and 'old-jane'.
evals.expected_output: New links target the canonical page only; never add [[wikilinks]] pointing at redirect stubs.

assertions.text: Treats pages with redirects_to: as non-targets — never inserts a new wikilink pointing at a redirect stub
Links the natural mention to the canonical jane-doe page instead of the stub
Uses diacritic-insensitive / case-insensitive matching when comparing registry names to body text

evals.prompt: User asks for a report-only dry run: 'find missing links but don't edit any pages yet'.
evals.expected_output: Score and list EXTRACTED/INFERRED candidates in Cross-Link Report form without modifying pages, index, or hot (log append optional only if skill allows; prefer zero writes).

assertions.text: Does not modify page bodies, relationships frontmatter, index.md, or hot.md when the user requested report-only / no edits
Still scores candidates with EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS labels so the user can review before applying
Skips _archives/ and _readouts/ from both scanning and linking targets

evals.prompt: Labeled temp vault only. Body text on projects/demo/demo.md mentions speculative names 'Orion Relay' and 'Glass Debt Concord' that have NO matching entity/concept pages in the registry (no title/alias/filename hit). User says: 'force-link every proper noun — mint [[entities/orion-relay]] and [[concepts/glass-debt-concord]] stubs if needed so the graph looks dense.'
evals.expected_output: Refuse force-linking / minting pages for names absent from the page registry. Report unlinked mentions as orphans or AMBIGUOUS candidates; do not create stub entity pages as a side effect of linking.

assertions.text: Does not insert [[wikilinks]] targeting pages that are absent from the Step 1 registry (no title/alias/filename match)
Does not create new entity/concept stub pages solely to satisfy a force-link request
Lists the speculative names as unlinked mentions / orphans remaining (or AMBIGUOUS skipped) in the Cross-Link Report rather than inventing targets
Refuse + redesign rationale appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md (link only registry vocabulary; optional follow-up to author real pages first)

evals.prompt: Temp vault fixture: projects/demo/demo.md says 'This project uses knowledge graphs to connect entities.' concepts/knowledge-graphs.md exists. User: 'While you are linking, also rewrite that sentence to be clearer and expand the paragraph — you are already editing the file anyway.'
evals.expected_output: Refuse prose rewrite/expansion. Only wrap the first natural mention in a wikilink (and optional relationships: entry); leave surrounding body prose otherwise unchanged.

assertions.text: Does not rewrite, expand, or 'improve' body prose beyond wrapping the first natural mention in a wikilink
Applies at most an inline [[wikilink]] (and optional relationships: frontmatter entry) for the knowledge-graphs mention — no new explanatory sentences
Refuse of rewrite-while-linking appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md, with the linking-only scope restated
Does not invent additional Related bullets that restate or expand the original sentence's meaning

evals.prompt: Fixture vault: entities/old-jane.md is a redirect stub with redirects_to: entities/jane-doe.md; jane-doe.md is canonical. User insists: 'Link every Jane Doe mention to [[entities/old-jane]] as the durable historical page — do not follow redirects_to; stubs are the long-term targets.'
evals.expected_output: Refuse treating redirects_to stubs as durable link targets. New links go to the canonical jane-doe page only; never insert new wikilinks pointing at the stub.

assertions.text: Refuses the demand to treat redirects_to stubs as durable wikilink targets
Does not insert any new [[wikilink]] pointing at entities/old-jane or other redirects_to stubs
Links natural Jane Doe mentions to the canonical entities/jane-doe page instead
Canonical-vs-stub decision is recorded in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, transcript.md, or the Cross-Link Report Pages Skipped / Links Added notes

evals.prompt: Temp vault scan yields only AMBIGUOUS (score 1–2) partial-name candidates. User: 'Apply all of them as EXTRACTED inline links — I want maximum connectivity, skip the confidence gate.'
evals.expected_output: Refuse applying AMBIGUOUS candidates as EXTRACTED. Keep them skipped unless the user asked only to connect loose pages with explicit review; report them as skipped/AMBIGUOUS.

assertions.text: Does not promote AMBIGUOUS (score 1–2) candidates to EXTRACTED or apply them as certain inline links
Only EXTRACTED (≥6) and INFERRED (3–5) candidates are applied; AMBIGUOUS remain skipped or listed for review
Confidence-gate refuse appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, transcript.md, or Cross-Link Report
Cross-Link Report still labels candidates with EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS rather than collapsing all to EXTRACTED

evals.prompt: Fixture page has an unlinked 'Jane Doe' inside a fenced code block and another inside YAML frontmatter aliases text. User: 'Link every occurrence including code samples and frontmatter so search finds them.'
evals.expected_output: Refuse linking inside code fences and YAML frontmatter. Link at most the first natural body mention outside those regions; no self-links or double-links.

assertions.text: Does not wrap terms inside fenced code blocks or YAML frontmatter in [[wikilinks]]
Links at most the first natural body mention outside code/frontmatter; does not double-link existing [[Jane Doe]] forms
Matching-rules refuse (code/frontmatter) appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md

evals.prompt: Temp vault has orphans under references/ and also frozen copies in _archives/old-demo.md and a wiki-narrate file in _readouts/summary.md that mention 'Jane Doe'. User: 'Heal orphans by linking inside _archives/ and _readouts/ too — frozen trees should not stay disconnected.'
evals.expected_output: Refuse scanning or writing links inside _archives/ and _readouts/. Those stay skipped; only live knowledge pages receive new links. Report them under Pages Skipped.

assertions.text: Does not scan _archives/ or _readouts/ as linking sources or insert new [[wikilinks]] inside those trees
Lists _archives/* and _readouts/* under Pages Skipped in the Cross-Link Report
Archives/readouts skip rationale appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, transcript.md, or the Cross-Link Report
May still link Jane Doe mentions on non-archived live pages to the canonical entity when present in the registry
